$comment: Every user-visible string in the interface, verbatim from the pre-refactor JSX. Copy edits, including the typos noted below, are made here, not in components. Curly apostrophes and the ellipsis character are intentional and reproduce the original rendering exactly.

brand.name: Clue-ai
brand.tagline: An AI that helps students troubleshoot assignments without directly giving the answer.

ask.label: What do you need help with?
ask.placeholder: Describe the bug, the goal, or what confuses you…

upload.prompt: Drag & drop or click to upload images

actions.$comment: helpIdle/helpBusy swap on the same button while a request is in flight.
actions.newPrompt: New Prompt or Clear Existing Prompt and Response
actions.newPromptTitle: Clear current question and start fresh

response.heading: AI Response
response.$placeholderComment: Rendered before the first request. `{subject}` is replaced with the active subject's shortLabel, lowercased. The original inlined `modeReadable(subjectMode).toLowerCase()` here.
response.placeholderLead: Press {action} to start. I’ll analyze your {subject} work, images, and context and return coaching-only steps (no spoilers).
response.$placeholderBulletsComment: "a screenshots" is a typo present in the shipped copy. It is reproduced verbatim so this extraction is a pure move; fix it here when you want the wording changed.
placeholderBullets: Upload a screenshots of the assignment
Describe what you need help with
response.$errorPrefixComment: Prepended to a caught error's message; the fallback below is used when the API returns no text at all.
response.emptyResponseFallback: Sorry, I couldn’t generate guidance this time.

history.heading: Past Questions
history.$descriptionComment: `{count}` is the configured history cap from data/config.json (limits.historyEntries), which the original hard-coded as the word "10".
history.description: Review the past {count} questions you had, what you uploaded, and how Clue-ai responded. Click on the box to see more details.

footer.text: Built for students • Edison Law 2025 • San Ramon Valley Unified School District • v1.2.7

errors.$comment: Messages thrown client-side and returned by the API routes.
errors.extractFailed: Failed to extract code from image
